summary: Script has solid practices (set -euo pipefail, input validation, error handling), but workflow depends on missing fixture files (fixtures/case*.txt), preventing execution. Workflow hardcodes expected results (lines 70-72) rather than discovering them; these should be derived from actual test fixtures. Task required red/green TDD with bats tests—none provided; only inline bash assertions exist. Parallel arrays in script (mark_delete, policy sections) are fragile and lack unit-test isolation. Core functionality appears correct, but solution incomplete: fixtures, bats suite, and TDD evidence missing.
